Our client is an international company headquartered in the Antwerpen region with over 30 years of experience at the international scale. They are looking for an IT Project Manager acting as a primary stakeholder in project coordination (applications and infrastructure) as well as technologies related to SAP within the company.

Jobomschrijving

The IT Project Manager is a key stakeholder in project coordination concerning all IT-related matters within the company. This individual will collaborate with internal business stakeholders and external support partners to ensure smooth day-to-day operations. The role requires a business-focused expert who can advocate for user needs and take the necessary actions for planning and support.

Key responsibilities:

Business System Support:

• 

Act as a super-user and system expert for SAP (ERP), specifically for the S4Hana and Coupa modules (with 80% of the projects being finance-related).
• Understand the architecture and process flows of ERP, Process Control, and related manufacturing systems
• Monitor system health and stability.
• Troubleshoot and address system issues, outages, and functional needs, engaging support partners as needed
• Support business users as a subject matter expert on existing and proposed system functionality
• Act as program manager and project stakeholder for system upgrades and enhancements

End User Support:

• Act as the first responder for user desktop issues (hardware and software), engaging the help desk and support partners as needed.
• Facilitate requests for purchases.
• Observe and anticipate user needs, and make appropriate recommendations for improvement.

Infrastructure, Process and Policy:

• Assist users in understanding IT Policy, Process, and Systems.
• Support business leadership in strategic planning and project oversight.
• Coordinate site activities for upgrades and system maintenance.
• Make recommendations for enhancements that will improve system function, capabilities, and stability.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT or engineering field.
• Proven ability to work across functional and regional boundaries, challenge status quo, and handle multiple projects simultaneously while delivering on time and on budget.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication and change management skills.
• 3-8 years' experience in IT role in a global company.
• Mixed skills should include configuration and expertise in SAP Coupa and S4Hana.

• Excellent knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint; experience with SAP is required.

As Technical Lead in the night shift, you will be the team lead of all technical profiles (8 people) in this shift in order to maximize production output while ensuring compliance with defined quality standards. You will coordinate and coach all technical profiles and manages the escalations. More specifically, you will:
 
 
 
• Ensure that equipment performance meets targets and minimize manufacturing failures. 
 
• Support in technical issues on the shop-floor and managing the escalation flow. 
 
• Develop and coach technical personnel to reach higher team results. 
 
• Be responsible for the administration of the personnel in the shift - holidays, sick leaves, transportation, competency review, etc. 
 
• Lead and coordinate escalations with other departments to resolve technical issues promptly. 
 
• Distribute the technical tasks among technical personnel in the shift, setting up team priorities, and making follow-ups on the progress during the shift. 
 
• Participate in improvement projects. Support the recruitment of technical personnel if needed. 
 
• Support / lead the local certification process (depending if there is a training department on site or not). 

Your profile
 
 
 
• Relevant Bachelor degree or Technician with around 5 years of relevant experience.  
 
• Good knowledge of technical coaching principles. 
 
• Excellent communication, team collaboration and targeted mentoring skills. 
 
• Good knowledge of MS office/Google.  
 
• Good understanding of English. 
 
• Ability to use all necessary job-related tools and make precise manual adjustments. 
 
• Analytical, logical, and interpretive mindset for complex technical data. 
 
• Proven ability to lead and coordinate technical activities on a shift or zone level.

Internship AB Inbev (Jupiler, Corona, Flying Fish, ...) - Brand management - 3 to 6 months - Leuven 
 
#Talent 
 
Purpose: 
 
Brewing the world's most loved beers and building brands consumers love, AB InBev is where ownership, ambition, and action thrive. 
 
We empower you to dream big, lead change, and create a long-lasting legacy. 
 
We value relentless problem-solvers who take accountability, embrace challenges, and turn bold goals into results through resilience and hard work. 
 
That's Who We Are: Come and OWN IT. 
 
Internship description: 
 
The purpose of the role is to assist the Senior Brand Manager(s) in driving growth for one of our key brands [Jupiler, Corona or Flying Fish].  

Our Brand teams bridge the gap between supporting brand building, brand activations, campaigns, and consumer engagement. We're looking for a proactive and ambitious students to join us and gain hands-on experience in one of the most dynamic and exciting industries. This is more than just an internship - it's a chance to start your career with us. Outstanding interns will be considered for full-time roles post-graduation. 
 
What will you do during the internship? 

• Assist with planning and follow-up of activations and campaigns  
• Support creation of marketing materials and content  
• Analyze consumer trends and competitor activities  
• Share insights on the lifestyle, habits, and culture of younger adult consumers  
• Work closely with sales, trade marketing, and external partners  
 
Internship duration: 
 
Flexible start date between October and December 2026, minimum 3 months and maximum 6 months.  
 
Work environment 
 
Work from our GHQ office in Leuven. The office is just a ten-minute walk from the Leuven train station.  

Compensation: 
 
Unpaid (with potential for full-time employment post-internship) 
 
What we're looking for: 

• Students with strong knowledge of their own consumer world and peer culture  
• Curious, creative, digitally fluent  
• Interest in marketing and consumer trends  
• Proactive, hands-on, team-oriented  
• Strong communication and organizational skills  
• You are fluent in English and Dutch or French 
• You are proficient in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Nielsen is a plus. 
• You have an internship agreement from your University. 
 
 
 
Why build your career with us: 
 
We recruit for mindset, ambition, cultural fit, and growth opportunities. 
 
UNIQUE CULTURE  
We are proud to be part of something bigger than ourselves and are passionate about building upon our company's long legacy. We believe in collaboration and candor, which results in a dynamic culture with open communication. 
  
BRANDS EVERYONE LOVES  
We are part of the collective, global history of beer. We are the proud makers of more than 500 iconic brands, from beloved international classics to local favorites. 
 
GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES  
Our people grow at the pace of their talent. We empower our people to learn, expand their perspectives, and unlock career growth. 
 
If this sounds like the incredible opportunity you've been waiting for, apply today. 
  

#LI-ABI ZoneEUR

About Tiense Suikerraffinaderij
For nearly 200 years, Tiense Suikerraffinaderij has been producing sugar from local sugar beets, serving both industries and home kitchens. You'll become part of a family of 600 proud sugar makers who stick together, both on and off the factory floor. They operate with a refined blend of tradition and innovation, aiming for minimal environmental impact as nothing from our sugar beets goes to waste. Our mission? To make life sweeter for people worldwide. And we're excited to do it together with you!

Jobomschrijving

Sweet Challenges Await: Join Our Headquarters in Tienen 
Are you ready to make a sweet impact in a dynamic environment, right at the heart of sugar production? As a Business Controller, you act as a business partner to operations, sales and other departments of Tiense Suikerraffinaderij in Belgium. Our business controllers are responsible for the cost and margin analysis of processes related to the development, manufacturing and packaging of sugar products in our different factories. For this specific function, we look for a colleague who likes to focus on improvement of financial reporting tools and business performance dashboards.

Your job as Business Controller 
At Tiense Suikerraffinaderij, we boast an impressive lineup of 6 factories, each specializing in unique sugar processes. Ensuring optimal efficiency and cost effectiveness across all operations is essential to our success. Your main responsibilities are, together with your colleague business controller: 

• You develop automatic and easy-speaking cost analyses and dashboards. 
• You create added value by making recommendations and thus enabling well-founded business decisions. You develop, maintain and follow up on business data (e.g. budgets, forecasts, cost targets, KPI) and monitor cost efficiencies through the whole chain
• You play an active role in the monthly and yearly closings and the regular forecasting process.
• You report to the Director Controlling. You report to and work together with the colleagues of the Südzucker Group. 

It is in our roots. In yours too? 
At Tiense Suikerraffinaderij, we've been making sugar since 1836. The ingredients for success? They're ingrained in our roots:

• Flexibility and curiosity – We continue to invest in better, more sustainable and more efficient ways of working. As we modernise our processes and equipment, your expertise and ideas will help us make the right choices and drive continuous improvement.
• Technology and common sense – You'll work in a technologically advanced manufacturing environment where data, experience and common sense go hand in hand. By gaining insight into manufacturing costs and collaborating with colleagues across departments, you'll help turn insights into practical improvements.
• Solo and as a team – You'll enjoy a high degree of autonomy and the freedom to take ownership of your work. At the same time, you'll be part of a collaborative environment where teams support one another and work together towards shared goals.
You should also possess the following qualifications and experiences:

• Master's Degree (e.g. economics)
• Minimum 5 years of experience in business/operational controlling or in an analyst function
• A strong affinity with IT tools: 
• knowledge of Excel including pivot tables is essential
• experience in creating reports and dashboards with a modern tool set is required 
• knowledge of SAP FiCo / SAP BI is an asset 
• Excellent level of spoken and written Dutch and English; good level of French
• Strong competencies in and interest for business analytics, as well as a good understanding of accounting
• Hands-on, proactive, and solution-oriented approach

ABOUT ACE
 

ACE, founded in 1977, is an international engineering group, with more than 200 people and with operations in Belgium, the Netherlands, Poland and Portugal. We combine engineering, consultancy, (prototype) machine building and product development, working with customers across a range of industrial sectors.
 

Our different activities and entities require a finance organisation that works effectively across borders, with consistent processes, reporting and controls. Further harmonising Finance across the group is therefore an important step in the continued development of ACE.
 

THE ROLE
 

As Head of Finance, you will have overall financial responsibility for ACE in Belgium, the Netherlands, Poland and Portugal. You will define the financial processes, reporting principles and controls across the group and further align financial operations across the different countries.
 

You will shape the financial architecture of the group on reporting, accounting, tax, budgeting, cashflow management and business performance analysis.
 

You will take a hands-on approach, further embed the accounting processes within the ERP system and deliver timely and reliable financial visibility of the business to the Board and management of the group.
 

As a member of the Management Team, you will bring financial insight to operational and strategic decision-making in support of the growth of the group.
 

 
 

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
 

- Act as a strategic financial partner, providing clear insight on performance, growth initiatives
 

and value creation across the different countries and entities.
 

- Optimise working capital and cash discipline (invoicing, billing, cash conversion,
 

WIP/inventory).
 

- Enhance visibility into profitability by customer, project, service line, country and legal
 

entity.
 

- Lead, mentor and develop the finance teams, creating a high-performance culture focused
 

on accountability and continuous improvement.
 

- Strengthen and safeguard compliance, governance and risk management across the group.
 

You will directly manage the finance teams in Lummen (BE), Bruges (BE), Eindhoven (NL) and
 

Poznan (PL) and work directly with the branch manager in Porto (PT). You will report directly to the member of the Board at group level.
 

 
 

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?
 

- At least 10 years of relevant experience in finance, including experience with broad financial
 

responsibility.
 

- Experience working across multiple legal entities. International experience is an advantage.
 

- Broad financial expertise covering accounting, controlling, consolidation, budgeting,
 

forecasting and cash flow.
 

- Experience leading and developing finance professionals.
 

- Strong analytical skills combined with a hands-on approach and the willingness to take on
 

operational financial matters yourself.
 

- Experience structuring and improving financial processes in a multi-entity environment.
 

- Experience in an industrial, engineering or project-driven environment is preferred.
 

- Experience with ERP systems; knowledge of AFAS is an advantage.
 

- Full professional proficiency in Dutch and English.
 

 
 

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE INTERESTING?
 

You will take on a broad financial mandate across four countries, with direct involvement in the management and decision-making of the group. The role gives you the opportunity to further shape the finance organisation, bring greater consistency across the different entities and have a visible impact on the further development of the group.
 

Interested? We look forward to your application.

As an AP Accountant based in Merksem, you will play a key role in managing accounts payable processes within the industrial and manufacturing sector. This permanent position involves handling financial transactions and ensuring accuracy in the accounting and finance department.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

An organisation in the industrial and manufacturing sector located in Merksem, Antwerp.

Omschrijving

As an AP Accountant your responsibilities are:

• Ensure supplier invoices, bank transactions, and cash allocations are processed accurately and on time every day.
• Play a key role in preparing and following up on vendor payments and managing A/P reconciliations.
• Keep international cash flows running smoothly by accurately matching payments across multiple currencies.
• Investigate discrepancies and complex accounting issues, taking ownership of finding and implementing solutions.
• Ensure quality and compliance with Belgian accounting standards, VAT regulations, and internal controls.
• Build strong partnerships with colleagues across Treasury, Accounting, TCU, and the business.
• Challenge existing ways of working and actively contribute to process improvements.
• Support the ongoing digitalization and automation of our Accounts Payable processes.

A successful AP Accountant should have:

• A Bachelor's degree in Accounting, or equivalent through relevant experience.
• At least 3 years of experience in Accounts Payable or operational accounting in an international environment, enabling you to work independently.
• Solid knowledge of invoice processing, reconciliations, payments and closing activities.
• Accurate and analytical, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify practical improvements.
• Hands-on, proactive and comfortable working in a high-volume and evolving environment.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is highly valued.
• Excellent command of English an good knowledge in Dutch.
